name: network-zones
title: Network zones
summary: Six FRR routers: two on the lab network in default, two in zone-a and two in zone-b, each zone on its own subnet with a worker of its own.
demonstrates: routing by network zone: each zone's discovery runs on the worker inside that zone, the only one that can reach its devices
stamping: discovered devices are recorded in the zone their job ran in
a central worker serving default beside workers serving one zone each
moving a device to another zone with a workflow run
zones created in the CMS before any zone worker starts
